open(bool,uint256,uint256).details: Notional = marginUsd * leverage. Size (token units) = notional / entry.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

settle(uint256,uint256).details: The trader receives equity back in margin tokens; insurance covers any      shortfall (equity below the liquidation level has already been caught      by the spot trigger).

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

depositInsurance(uint256).notice: Fund the counterparty/Takaful pool: anyone may deposit margin         tokens; the pool backs winners' payouts and absorbs socialized         losses. REAL token backing (not an accounting number).

isLiquidatable(address).notice: Trigger check: equity computed at the HEALTH price (spot-aware).

liquidate(address,uint256).notice: Keeper liquidation. Triggered by the LIVE SPOT price (fast), then         closed and settled at TWAP (fair). Reward paid in margin tokens.

open(bool,uint256,uint256).notice: Open a synthetic position. Margin is pulled from the trader in         `marginToken` and converted to USD at the TWAP entry price.

settle(uint256,uint256).notice: Close a position. P&L is settled at the CURRENT TWAP (fair value).

withdrawInsuranceSurplus().notice: Owner withdraws ONLY surplus above the OI-based safety floor.
